name: comb_operation_budget

design_requirements.confirmation_notes: Remote fixture proving a registered replacement for an over-budget combinational chain.

description: Register two pairwise terms, combine them on the following cycle, and expose a valid result with explicit latency.
behavior: Clear all pipeline state during active-low reset.
Capture the two pairwise AND terms when i_valid is asserted.
One cycle later, output the OR of the registered terms and assert o_valid.
Hold o_valid and o_match stable while i_output_ready is deasserted, and conserve every accepted transaction.
constraints: Keep every register D-input and continuous output bridge within three combinational operations.
Preserve the documented two-edge result latency when the pipeline is not stalled.
Honor ready/valid backpressure without loss, duplication, or output changes during a stall.
notes: comb_operation_budget_bad.v is a gate-only negative probe and is intentionally excluded from simulation outputs.
